question: Which Uniswap v4 pool on Base did the most native-ETH volume in the last hour excluding pools whose other side is WETH, WBTC, cbBTC or USDC?

definitions.selection: the first entry answers the question; ties broken by pool id ascending
definitions.denomination: native ETH, the absolute swapped amount on the ETH side of pools whose currency0 is native ETH (address zero)

answer.notes: Ran a locally modified copy of scan.mjs --v4 (same computation; changes only for rate limits: pool keys read via Multicall3 aggregate3 against PositionManager 0x7c5f5a4bbd8fd63184577525326123b519429bdc at latest, since poolKeys is immutable, and the Initialize backfill for pools unknown to PositionManager filtered on topic2 = native ETH, since only ETH pools can carry the token). Endpoint used for logs and Initialize history: https://base.rpc.sentio.xyz (pin confirmed by the script); https://mainnet.base.org for pool keys. Public endpoints heavily 429ed. 981 pools traded, 277 with native ETH, 9997 swaps. The 261 pools left unresolved are non-ETH pools (no ETH Initialize log). Assumed WBTC on Base = 0x0555e30da8f98308edb960aa94c0db47230d2b9c. The stock scan.mjs could not finish on these endpoints, so the deployer should confirm on its own RPC.
